# Omar Farouk

> Lead Software Developer at Venneir (2026–present), building and maintaining internal tools for a large dental-industry business with an AI-assisted workflow (Claude, Supabase, Vercel, GitHub). Previously a freelance developer (2023–2026) who shipped 10+ commercial web, mobile and desktop products with Flutter, PHP and MySQL. Based in Cairo, Egypt.
